name: training

collision.note: The static collider arena.js builds: one box per solid ([floor, ...map.boxes]) plus map.barriers (invisible walls and caps), and one 20° wedge prism per map.wedges entry. Boxes are {min: [x, y, z], max: [x, y, z], kind}. The core pillars are a separate live collider (see core). Survival adds locked zones as solid boxes at run time (the zone parts of every locked zone).
collision.wedgeNote: a wedge rises `rise` m over `length` m along a = (-sin yaw, -cos yaw) from its low-end centre (x, z); width across. Faces: slope, back (vertical, at `length`), two sides (arena.js wedgeGeometry)

triangles.note: every distinct triangle in the built static Octree (boxes, barriers, wedges; not the core), flat [ax, ay, az, bx, by, bz, cx, cy, cz] per triangle, in the Octree's order; coordinates come from Float32 geometry buffers

droppedByOctree.note: box triangles (from the same BoxGeometry arena.js uses) that the built Octree does not hold, so they never collide in the game. three/addons/math/Octree.js calcBox() pads only the min corner of the bounds, so a face exactly on a max plane of octreeBounds can fall outside every child box during split(). allOnMaxPlanes: every dropped triangle lies in the plane x, y or z = octreeBounds.max

padNote: a pad with a target launches with padLaunchVelocity(from, target, apexAbove, g, fallGravityMult); without one straight up to config.jumpPad.apexHeight (arena.checkPads)

navGrid.columnCenter: column c: x = origin + (c % size + 0.5) * cell, z = origin + (floor(c / size) + 0.5) * cell

nodes.note: parallel arrays, one entry per node (index = node id). x, z: the column centre; y: floor height; clear: headroom to the next surface above (m); tag: zone index (-1: none); edge: 1 when a floor is missing under one side of the body; col: column index; blocked: all 0 at build (locked zones are masked at run time by tag)

links.note: CSR: node i's links are linkStart[i] .. linkStart[i + 1] - 1; linkTo = target node, linkKind = linkKinds value, linkCost = m-equivalent cost

navGrid.tagAt: none (every tag is -1), as main.js when no zones are loaded

signs.text: HOLD {slide} TO SLIDE · {jump} WHILE SLIDING = SLIDE JUMP
1.8 m: DOUBLE JUMP ({jump} IN THE AIR)
10 m GAP: DOUBLE JUMP OR DASH JUMP ({dash}, THEN {jump})
WALL RIDE: JUMP ALONG A WALL · {jump} = WALL JUMP (3 MAX)
SLAM: {slide} IN THE AIR · {jump} ON LANDING = BOOST JUMP
HOLD RIGHT MOUSE TO ZOOM · A ZOOMED KESTREL SHOT OFF A WALL RICOCHETS ONTO AN ENEMY
H: SPAWN HUSKS · K: CLEAR · {punch}: PUNCH (PARRY A FLASHING HUSK)

dataNote: the whole map object arena.load() returned (the level data, including everything above)
